prompt: A streamlined car has a curved-roof cabin and four separate wheels. The cabin stands over the main body, while the wheels attach in front and rear pairs on its two sides. Rounded solid surfaces carry the connected parts. Across the whole car, width is about 0.68 of front-to-back length and height is about 0.69 of width.
prompt_zh: 一辆流线汽车，有弧顶驾驶舱和四个独立车轮。驾驶舱位于主体车身上方，前后轮对分居两侧并连接车身。圆润的实体表面承载相接的部件。整车宽度约为前后长度的 0.68 倍，高度约为宽度的 0.69 倍。

evidence.reference_caption: A streamlined car with curved cabin roof and four separate wheels. The cabin rises over the body; four attached wheels occupy the left and right front and rear positions. Curved substantial surfaces carry their continuously attached functional parts. Overall width is 0.68 times depth; height is 0.69 times width. Parts follow functional positions.
evidence.level_rule: 基础结构、连续曲面与部件连接，加 dataset 中的实际比例；不添加配色。

prompt_zh: 一辆流线汽车，有弧顶驾驶舱和四个独立车轮。驾驶舱位于主体车身上方，前后轮对分居两侧并连接车身。圆润的实体表面承载相接的部件。整车宽度约为前后长度的 0.68 倍，高度约为宽度的 0.69 倍。车身和驾驶舱为红色，车窗为浅蓝色，四轮为近黑色，各部位采用连续色区。正视显示功能部件，侧视和俯视显示其厚度、连接及布局。

evidence.reference_caption: A streamlined car with curved cabin roof and four separate wheels. The cabin rises over the body; four attached wheels occupy the left and right front and rear positions. Curved substantial surfaces carry their continuously attached functional parts. Overall width is 0.68 times depth; height is 0.69 times width. Parts follow functional positions. evidence.level_rule: 包含 L1–L4 信息，再加训练中真实存在的部件配色与观察视角。
